body: Chuck and I met in the late 80’s (sheesh!) at a Leadership Network event. We’ve both been through a lot since then, and have been friends to one another through a lot of life’s ups and downs. I subscribe to his email “Reflexion,” which is one of the spiritual resources that enriches me week by week. He just launched a new website to make his many valuable resources available … I encourage you to check it out (and sign up for Reflexions!) here.
